parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same root cause: after the final failed attempt the loop breaks and charge() returns None instead of re-raising GatewayError, so the error is swallowed. Both trace the downstream AttributeError on charge.id and the batch abort in settle_open_invoices. They differ in details (A says the invoice is never marked payment_failed; B says it is marked PAID first), but the defect and location are the same.
